Corpus Christi: commercial boiler inspection, neutral third-party NDT and how local providers compare

The largest single search that reaches this page is "commercial boiler inspection Corpus Christi TX". In Texas that inspection is a legal certificate inspection, and two groups make it: inspectors of an authorized inspection agency, usually tied to the boiler's insurer, and the state's own deputy boiler inspectors. Atlantis is neither. What Atlantis can add is conventional NDT, such as ultrasonic thickness readings or a magnetic particle crack check, when the boiler inspector or the repair organization asks for that data.

Who inspects a commercial boiler in Corpus Christi?

The Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation (TDLR) runs the boiler program. Certificate inspections fall every 12, 24 or 36 months depending on the boiler type, and each one must be done before the current certificate of operation expires. If an authorized inspection agency insures the boiler, that agency's inspector does the certificate inspection; uninsured boilers are inspected by TDLR's deputy inspectors. The owner keeps the certificate posted on or near the boiler and keeps a competent attendant available. Hotels, schools, hospitals and office buildings with steam or hot-water boilers all sit inside this system, so a commercial boiler inspection starts with a call to your insurer's inspection agency or to TDLR.

NDT supports that inspection rather than replacing it. After overheating, a tube leak or a long outage, the inspector may want UT thickness on drums, headers or tubes, or MT and PT at cracked ligaments and attachment welds before a repair. See ultrasonic boiler tube thickness testing and ultrasonic testing in Corpus Christi.

What makes a third-party inspection "neutral"?

Neutral means the examiner has no stake in the result: no part in building, repairing or selling the equipment, and no bonus tied to accepting it. One party still pays the bill, so neutrality comes from method, not from who signs the purchase order. Agree the procedure, acceptance criteria and calibration before work starts; let every interested party witness; and record readings so anyone can repeat them. A neutral third-party lab, by contrast, tests samples sent to it: chemistry, tensile tests or failure analysis.

The Corpus Christi equipment base

Valero and Flint Hills Resources run refineries in Corpus Christi, and CITGO operates a refinery there too. Cheniere's liquefaction and export terminal sits on the La Quinta Channel in San Patricio County. The Port of Corpus Christi calls itself the nation's largest energy export gateway and ranks itself third in the world among crude oil export ports. For field NDT that means:

  • UT thickness on refinery piping and drums at condition monitoring locations, for the owner's API 570 and API 510 inspectors
  • wet fluorescent MT on carbon steel welds in sour and amine service: magnetic particle testing in Corpus Christi
  • PT on austenitic stainless LNG piping and cold-service welds, where MT does not work: penetrant testing for LNG plants
  • VT of marine loading docks, pipe supports and external corrosion in salt air

How local providers compare

Many searches here name IRISNDT, which lists Corpus Christi among its Texas locations along with Houston, Beaumont and Deer Park and offers NDT, advanced NDT, engineering, laboratory work and rope access. Mistras lists a Corpus Christi branch with API 510, 570 and 653 inspection, AWS certified welding inspectors, rope access, pipeline services and its PCMS software. Firms like these suit an owner who wants API-certified inspectors and NDT from one contract. Atlantis is narrower: it supplies conventional NDT and ASNT Level III oversight, does not supply API inspectors and is not a boiler inspection agency. Ask any bidder which written practice certifies the technicians, which Level III approved the procedures and when the report will be issued.

Atlantis in Corpus Christi

Atlantis is based in Houston, and crews travel to Corpus Christi, Ingleside and Portland sites for agreed dates. Any radiography in the scope is handled by the owner's licensed radiography contractor, because Atlantis does not perform radiography in the United States.
